name: TDProjectile
src_typeComment: Homing projectile spawned by TDProjectileAttack: tracks its target's LIVE position (not just where it was at launch) and deals damage on arrival. Self-destructs harmlessly if the target is destroyed mid-flight (e.g. killed by another tower first) instead of erroring on a stale reference.

src_serialized.name: hitDistance
src_serialized.tooltip: Distance from the target that counts as a hit.
